title: Generic cook: Object and ChildObject blocks to typed bundle rows
detail: importer/cook/objects.py: every Object/ChildObject/ObjectReskin in the effective tree becomes one bundle row with its module list and fields, no faction profile. Denominator: 5,494 unique object identifiers. Unknown module types are kept verbatim with a gap flag, never dropped.
oracle: python -m pytest importer/tests/test_cook_objects.py -q   # round-trip: parse, emit, reload, compare every assignment to source
